snippet.title: Party Club: Hangry Animals – First Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the next chapter of Party Club 🐾
Party Club: Hangry Animals is our new party game experience, where hungry animals, chaotic situations with lots of mini games.

Built on the spirit of Party Club, Hangry Animals introduces:

Fast, chaotic party gameplay
Moments that go wrong very quickly 😅
Designed to be played with friends
This is just the first look.

More details, gameplay, and updates are coming soon.

👉 Wishlist and follow to stay updated
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4276750/Party_Club_Hangry_Animals/
Thanks for being part of the Party Club journey 🎉
